title: Shannon Snow
content:
Shannon Snow

Executive Function Coach

Coaching style

Safe, Compassionate, Gentle

Who I work best with

I help neurodivergent people who struggle to give themselves permission to care for their well-being to learn how to prioritize their Self while supporting their EF challenges.

Top areas I support

  • Overwhelm / shutdown / burnout
  • Emotional regulation
  • Motivation without shame
  • Eating patterns / intuitive eating support
  • PDA support

What sessions look like

In a typical session, we'll dig into what's working, figure out where the resistance is and what's blocking progress, (time blindness, burnout, shame, etc.,) and develop a strategy together that works for your unique brain. You'll leave with insight and a manageable tool to experiment with over the week.

Go-to strengths

  • Emotional regulation
  • PDA support
  • Motivation / avoidance
  • Burnout

Relevant experience

  • School Guidance Director (3 years)
  • High School Educator / Yearbook Advisor / Swim Coach (15/9/4 years)
  • Health/Life Coach (5 years)
  • Parent of a neurodivergent kiddo (10+ years)

Education & training

  • B.S., Psychology
  • Dual Certified Health Coach & Life Coach

Personal neurodivergent experience

I am AuDHD; I'm (late-diagnosed) ADHD and (self-discovered) autistic, and I coach from a place of flexibility, knowing from experience that each neurodivergent mind requires a unique approach.

Outside of coaching

Outside coaching, you'll find me hanging out with my hubby, kiddo, and cats while crocheting and watching a show I've seen a million times.
author: ChrisHanson
